content.summary: The inherited degree cap is attributed to the correct pinned theorem and is applicable without an additional extremal conjecture. I read the committed changes and manuscript, verified both frozen hashes, and verified the inspected source against its manifest digest. This targeted source check supports continuing; it does not independently reprove the inherited library.

checks.method: Read the named Erdos20ExtremalTransversals theorem and its immediate proof in F01.
checks.observation: Its hypotheses are rank-four uniformity, three-sunflower-freeness, intersection and at least 21 members. Its proof combines degree at most 20 with the preceding statement that degree 20 forces family size 20. Thus cardinality 28 satisfies every required hypothesis and excludes degree 20. The manuscript correctly identifies this as an inherited A1K input rather than a new bound or an assumption of I(27).
